name: minecraft-trim-pattern

schema.description: A trim pattern for a Minecraft data pack config schema
schema.title: Minecraft Data Pack Trim Pattern

description: The latest trim pattern added to the pack is the Diamond trim. Its asset identifier is **minecraft:trim_pattern/diamond**, and it references the translation key **trim_pattern.minecraft.diamond** for its name. The pattern is rendered in a bright cyan color (**#00FFFF**) and uses the standard **minecraft:diamond** item as its template.
